### Extreme Networks Announces Investor Conferences for November and December 2026


November 3, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/756692490/files/doc_news/Extreme-Networks-Announces-Investor-Conferences-for-November-and-December-2026-2026.pdf)


MORRISVILLE, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Extreme Networks](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.extremenetworks.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3D25_PR_Aug-Sept-Conf-Sched_0000_CORP_AAD_REF_LPG_WW_EN_PRE_home%26utm_medium%3DReferral%26utm_source%3DPR-Aug-Sept-Conf-Sched%26utm_content%3Dhome&esheet=54634349&newsitemid=20261103503388&lan=en-US&anchor=Extreme+Networks&index=1&md5=752ad0e552bb66d8ce5cdc03851abd1d) , Inc. (Nasdaq: EXTR), a leader in AI-powered automation for networking, today announced its investor conference schedule for November and December 2026:


- **BMO Technology and Innovation Leaders Conference** Stan Kovler, SVP, Finance and Corporate Development
New York, NY
Thursday, November 12, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


- **7th Annual Needham Virtual Tech Week: 1x1 Event** Kevin Rhodes, EVP and CFO
Virtual
Thursday, November 19, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


- **UBS Global Technology and AI Conference** Kevin Rhodes, EVP and CFO
Scottsdale, AZ
Wednesday, December 2, 2026
12:15 p.m. MT Fireside chat and meetings throughout the day


- **Raymond James TMT & Consumer Conference** Ed Meyercord, President and CEO
New York, NY
Monday, December 7, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


- **Wells Fargo 10th Annual TMT Summit** Kevin Rhodes, EVP and CFO
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA
Tuesday, December 8, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


- **Barclays 24th Annual Global Technology Conference** Kevin Rhodes, EVP and CFO
San Francisco, CA
Wednesday, December 9, 2026
Conducting meetings throughout the day


A live webcast from each fireside chat will be accessible under Events & Presentations on the Investor Relations section of the Extreme Networks website at[http://investor.extremenetworks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.extremenetworks.com&esheet=54634349&newsitemid=20261103503388&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.extremenetworks.com&index=2&md5=75ba834c6bce89e9c510318c431adecc) and will be archived for at least 30 days following the live presentation.


**About Extreme Networks:**


Extreme Networks, Inc. (EXTR) is a leader in AI-powered cloud networking, focused on delivering simple and secure solutions that help businesses address challenges and enable connections among devices, applications, and users. We push the boundaries of technology, leveraging the powers of artificial intelligence, analytics, and automation. Tens of thousands of customers globally trust our AI-powered cloud networking solutions and industry-leading support to enable businesses to drive value, foster innovation, and overcome extreme challenges. For more information, visit Extreme's website at[www.extremenetworks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.extremenetworks.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3D25_PR_Aug-Sept-Conf-Sched_0000_CORP_AAD_REF_LPG_WW_EN_PRE_home%26utm_medium%3DReferral%26utm_source%3DPR-Aug-Sept-Conf-Sched%26utm_content%3Dhome&esheet=54634349&newsitemid=20261103503388&lan=en-US&anchor=www.extremenetworks.com&index=3&md5=529fd965b0a7e8771d8a839f68fb26b0) or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fextreme-networks%2Fhome%2F&esheet=54634349&newsitemid=20261103503388&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=4&md5=5bf7ca2c0db55342e2d52640ea29e2f1) ,[YouTube](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fextremenetworks&esheet=54634349&newsitemid=20261103503388&lan=en-US&anchor=YouTube&index=5&md5=302f4ccd1b2697c8f7405529d78d04d9) ,[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fextremenetworks&esheet=54634349&newsitemid=20261103503388&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=6&md5=ce94ddf53a01889003d123c137ce2d09) ,[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fextremenetworks&esheet=54634349&newsitemid=20261103503388&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=7&md5=a3d5978a75d9a05685318934e020878f) , or[Instagram.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fextremenetworks%2F&esheet=54634349&newsitemid=20261103503388&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram.&index=8&md5=8e7987d07a549be5679005c6741b1fda)
